findings.title: Missing Primary Keys on Mapping Tables
findings.description: The tables 'campagne_contacts', 'campagne_tags', 'expediteur_groupe', and 'user_contact_tags' lack formal primary keys or composite unique constraints. While no duplicates were found during the current scan, this structure risks data duplication.
findings.remediation: Add composite primary keys to these mapping tables to enforce uniqueness and improve join performance.

findings.title: Critical Type Mismatch: MSISDN Storage
findings.description: There is a critical type mismatch between 'contacts.msisdn' (character varying), 'user_contact.contact_id' (character varying), and 'campagne_contacts.contact_id' (bigint). This prevents reliable joins and risks data loss if non-numeric MSISDNs are introduced.
findings.remediation: Standardize MSISDN/Contact ID columns to a consistent type, preferably 'character varying' to support international formats, or 'bigint' if strictly numeric.

findings.title: SMSC Identifier Integrity Violation
findings.description: The 'smsc' table uses an integer ID, but 'send_sms' and 'sent_sms' use 'character varying' for 'smsc_id'. Analysis found non-numeric values ('Orange', 'simulator') in the transaction logs that cannot be mapped to the master 'smsc' table.
findings.remediation: Migrate 'smsc_id' in transaction tables to integer and enforce a foreign key constraint after cleaning non-numeric identifiers.

findings.title: Suspicious Nulls in Campaign Logic
findings.description: The column 'groupe.admin_id' contains 8 NULL values. Given its role in administrative ownership, these NULLs may bypass business rules or indicate orphaned records.
findings.remediation: Investigate if these NULLs represent valid system states; otherwise, assign a default administrator or enforce NOT NULL.

findings.title: Suboptimal Indexing on High-Volume Tables
findings.description: High-volume tables 'user_contact' and 'user_contact_tags' rely on composite indexes for 'contact_id' and 'tag_id' respectively. They lack standalone indexes on these columns, which may degrade performance for single-column lookups.
findings.remediation: Create standalone indexes for 'user_contact(contact_id)' and 'user_contact_tags(tag_id)'.

findings.title: Redundant Unique Constraint in PRM Tables
findings.description: In 'prm_status', the 'code' column is unique across all types. Therefore, the composite unique constraint on '(code, type)' is redundant and adds unnecessary overhead.
findings.remediation: Remove the composite unique constraint and maintain only the unique constraint on 'code'.

findings.title: Missing Foreign Key Constraints
findings.description: Several columns ending in '_id' (e.g., 'campagne_contacts.contact_id', 'send_sms.smsc_id', 'audit_log.job_id') lack formal foreign key constraints, risking referential integrity.
findings.remediation: Establish formal foreign key constraints for all relational identifier columns.

findings.title: Duplicate Default Routing Rules
findings.description: Organization ID 2 has 4 'catch-all' default routing rules (where expediteur_id and groupe_id are both NULL). This violates the expected 1:1 relationship for default routes per organization and causes non-deterministic SMS gateway selection.
findings.remediation: Consolidate routing rules for Organization 2 so that only one default route exists.

findings.title: Orphaned Campaign Contacts
findings.description: 17 unique contact IDs in 'campagne_contacts' (e.g., 20033, 20046) do not exist in the master 'contacts.msisdn' table. This indicates a failure in referential integrity during contact deletion or campaign creation.
findings.remediation: Clean up orphaned records in 'campagne_contacts' and implement a foreign key constraint to 'contacts(msisdn)'.

findings.title: Non-Numeric Gateway Identifiers in Logs
findings.description: The 'sent_sms' table contains 'smsc_id' values 'Orange' and 'simulator'. These string identifiers cannot be mapped to the integer-based 'smsc.id' master table, breaking the relationship between transaction logs and gateway configurations.
findings.remediation: Standardize 'smsc_id' to use integer identifiers and migrate existing string labels to a lookup table or the 'smsc' master table.

findings.title: Orphaned Audit Logs
findings.description: 32 unique 'job_id' values in 'audit_log' do not reference any valid entry in the 'jobs' table. This suggests that parent job records were purged without cascading the deletion to the audit logs.
findings.remediation: Archive or delete audit logs that reference non-existent jobs and enforce cascading deletes if appropriate.

findings.title: Legacy User Migration Inconsistency
findings.description: 7 users in 'users_legacy' (including 'ebs@yopmail.com' and 'ranimt1@yopmail.com') are missing from the modern 'users' table. This indicates an incomplete or failed migration of user accounts.
findings.remediation: Verify if these legacy users should be migrated to the 'users' table or if the legacy records should be archived.

findings.title: Stale Campaign Spooler State
findings.description: The campaign spooler state (ID 2) has a 'last_updated_date' of 2025-03-06. Given the current system time of 2026-04-12, this indicates that the spooler process is stalled or the monitoring record is no longer being updated.
findings.remediation: Restart the campaign spooler service and investigate why the 'last_updated_date' is not being refreshed.

findings.title: Missing Primary Keys on Mapping Tables
findings.description: The tables 'campagne_contacts', 'campagne_tags', 'expediteur_groupe', and 'user_contact_tags' lack formal primary keys or composite unique constraints. While no duplicates were found during the current scan, this structure risks data duplication.
findings.remediation: Add composite primary keys to these mapping tables to enforce uniqueness and improve join performance.

findings.title: Critical Type Mismatch: MSISDN Storage
findings.description: There is a critical type mismatch between 'contacts.msisdn' (character varying), 'user_contact.contact_id' (character varying), and 'campagne_contacts.contact_id' (bigint). This prevents reliable joins and risks data loss if non-numeric MSISDNs are introduced.
findings.remediation: Standardize MSISDN/Contact ID columns to a consistent type, preferably 'character varying' to support international formats, or 'bigint' if strictly numeric.

findings.title: SMSC Identifier Integrity Violation
findings.description: The 'smsc' table uses an integer ID, but 'send_sms' and 'sent_sms' use 'character varying' for 'smsc_id'. Analysis found non-numeric values ('Orange', 'simulator') in the transaction logs that cannot be mapped to the master 'smsc' table.
findings.remediation: Migrate 'smsc_id' in transaction tables to integer and enforce a foreign key constraint after cleaning non-numeric identifiers.

findings.title: Suspicious Nulls in Campaign Logic
findings.description: The column 'groupe.admin_id' contains 8 NULL values. Given its role in administrative ownership, these NULLs may bypass business rules or indicate orphaned records.
findings.remediation: Investigate if these NULLs represent valid system states; otherwise, assign a default administrator or enforce NOT NULL.

findings.title: Suboptimal Indexing on High-Volume Tables
findings.description: High-volume tables 'user_contact' and 'user_contact_tags' rely on composite indexes for 'contact_id' and 'tag_id' respectively. They lack standalone indexes on these columns, which may degrade performance for single-column lookups.
findings.remediation: Create standalone indexes for 'user_contact(contact_id)' and 'user_contact_tags(tag_id)'.

findings.title: Redundant Unique Constraint in PRM Tables
findings.description: In 'prm_status', the 'code' column is unique across all types. Therefore, the composite unique constraint on '(code, type)' is redundant and adds unnecessary overhead.
findings.remediation: Remove the composite unique constraint and maintain only the unique constraint on 'code'.

findings.description: Several columns ending in '_id' (e.g., 'campagne_contacts.contact_id', 'send_sms.smsc_id', 'audit_log.job_id') lack formal foreign key constraints, risking referential integrity.

findings.description: 17 unique contact IDs in 'campagne_contacts' (e.g., 20033, 20046) do not exist in the master 'contacts.msisdn' table. This indicates a failure in referential integrity during contact deletion or campaign creation.

findings.description: The 'sent_sms' table contains 'smsc_id' values 'Orange' and 'simulator'. These string identifiers cannot be mapped to the integer-based 'smsc.id' master table, breaking the relationship between transaction logs and gateway configurations.
findings.remediation: Standardize 'smsc_id' to use integer identifiers and migrate existing string labels to a lookup table or the 'smsc' master table.

findings.title: Orphaned Audit Logs
findings.description: 32 unique 'job_id' values in 'audit_log' do not reference any valid entry in the 'jobs' table. This suggests that parent job records were purged without cascading the deletion to the audit logs.
findings.remediation: Archive or delete audit logs that reference non-existent jobs and enforce cascading deletes if appropriate.

findings.description: 7 users in 'users_legacy' (including 'ebs@yopmail.com' and 'ranimt1@yopmail.com') are missing from the modern 'users' table. This indicates an incomplete or failed migration of user accounts.
findings.remediation: Verify if these legacy users should be migrated to the 'users' table or if the legacy records should be archived.

findings.description: The campaign spooler state (ID 2) has a 'last_updated_date' of 2025-03-06. Given the current system time of 2026-04-12, this indicates that the spooler process is stalled or the monitoring record is no longer being updated.
findings.remediation: Restart the campaign spooler service and investigate why the 'last_updated_date' is not being refreshed.

findings.description: The tables 'campagne_contacts', 'campagne_tags', 'expediteur_groupe', and 'user_contact_tags' lack formal primary keys or composite unique constraints. While no duplicates were found during the current scan, this structure risks data duplication.
findings.remediation: Add composite primary keys to these mapping tables to enforce uniqueness and improve join performance.

findings.title: Critical Type Mismatch: MSISDN Storage
findings.description: There is a critical type mismatch between 'contacts.msisdn' (character varying), 'user_contact.contact_id' (character varying), and 'campagne_contacts.contact_id' (bigint). This prevents reliable joins and risks data loss if non-numeric MSISDNs are introduced.
findings.remediation: Standardize MSISDN/Contact ID columns to a consistent type, preferably 'character varying' to support international formats, or 'bigint' if strictly numeric.

findings.title: SMSC Identifier Integrity Violation
findings.description: The 'smsc' table uses an integer ID, but 'send_sms' and 'sent_sms' use 'character varying' for 'smsc_id'. Analysis found non-numeric values ('Orange', 'simulator') in the transaction logs that cannot be mapped to the master 'smsc' table.
findings.remediation: Migrate 'smsc_id' in transaction tables to integer and enforce a foreign key constraint after cleaning non-numeric identifiers.

findings.title: Suspicious Nulls in Campaign Logic
findings.description: The column 'groupe.admin_id' contains 8 NULL values. Given its role in administrative ownership, these NULLs may bypass business rules or indicate orphaned records.
findings.remediation: Investigate if these NULLs represent valid system states; otherwise, assign a default administrator or enforce NOT NULL.

findings.title: Suboptimal Indexing on High-Volume Tables
findings.description: High-volume tables 'user_contact' and 'user_contact_tags' rely on composite indexes for 'contact_id' and 'tag_id' respectively. They lack standalone indexes on these columns, which may degrade performance for single-column lookups.
findings.remediation: Create standalone indexes for 'user_contact(contact_id)' and 'user_contact_tags(tag_id)'.

findings.title: Redundant Unique Constraint in PRM Tables
findings.description: In 'prm_status', the 'code' column is unique across all types. Therefore, the composite unique constraint on '(code, type)' is redundant and adds unnecessary overhead.
findings.remediation: Remove the composite unique constraint and maintain only the unique constraint on 'code'.

findings.title: Missing Foreign Key Constraints
findings.description: Several columns ending in '_id' (e.g., 'campagne_contacts.contact_id', 'send_sms.smsc_id', 'audit_log.job_id') lack formal foreign key constraints, risking referential integrity.
findings.remediation: Establish formal foreign key constraints for all relational identifier columns.
